Our Story

Born out of love for the forgotten

Nuru Children's Home was established by Muteti Ndunda in 2023 with a single purpose: to ensure that no child in Athi River goes without shelter, food, and hope.

What started as one woman's act of compassion has grown into a home for over 103 rescued children — a community where every child is known by name, cared for daily, and given the tools to build a better future.

Located in Athi River, Nairobi, we work hand-in-hand with local families, partner NGOs, and international supporters including the Red Cross Middle East and Red Cross USA to deliver holistic care every single day.

Join Our Mission

What We Do

Every child gets what they need to grow.

From the moment a child arrives, we wrap them in care — body, mind, and spirit.

🏡

Safe Shelter

A secure, clean home for children rescued from neglect, abuse, or life on the streets — with 24/7 staff care.

🍽️

Daily Nutrition

Three nutritious meals prepared fresh every day. No child at Nuru goes to bed hungry.

📚

Education

School enrolment, supplies, and tutoring so every child has a pathway out of poverty.

❤️

Health & Wellness

Routine medical check-ups, vaccinations, and emotional support for every child in our care.

🎨

Play & Creativity

Art, games, celebrations, and music — because healing happens when children are free to just be children.

🤝

Community Support

We work with families and local organisations to reunite and strengthen the wider community around every child.
